text_blocks.snippet: Losartan commonly causes mild side effects like dizziness, tiredness, and stuffy nose, but can rarely lead to serious issues like high potassium or kidney changes.

list.snippet: Dizziness or lightheadedness: Happens when blood pressure drops, especially upon standing.
Fatigue: Feeling more tired as your body adjusts to lower blood pressure.
Cold symptoms: Stuffy nose, sneezing, or mild sore throat.
Digestive upset: Nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or mild stomach pain.
Back or joint pain: Aching muscles or stiffness in the joints.
Headache: Mild head pain during the first few weeks.
High potassium (hyperkalemia): Can cause muscle weakness or an irregular heartbeat.
Kidney problems: May lead to swelling in the legs or a big change in urination.
Low blood pressure (hypotension): Causes severe dizziness, confusion, or fainting.
Severe allergic reaction (angioedema): Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, making it hard to breathe.
Pregnancy warning: Losartan can cause severe harm or death to an unborn baby and must be stopped immediately if you become pregnant.
